body: Cardi B went OFF on this GloRilla and Cardi B went crazy on “Tomorrow 2,” but Cardi’s verse was a whole moment. Released in 2022, the remix brought two different rap styles together, with Cardi coming through with the confidence, punchlines and energy she’s known for. From brushing off her haters to flexing her success, Cardi had plenty to say on this verse. Her delivery matched the beat perfectly, and she even threw in a nod to Ice Spice’s “Munch (Feelin’ U).

source_caption_text:
Cardi B went OFF on this 😤🔥

GloRilla and Cardi B went crazy on “Tomorrow 2,” but Cardi’s verse was a whole moment. Released in 2022, the remix brought two different rap styles together, with Cardi coming through with the confidence, punchlines and energy she’s known for.

From brushing off her haters to flexing her success, Cardi had plenty to say on this verse. Her delivery matched the beat perfectly, and she even threw in a nod to Ice Spice’s “Munch (Feelin’ U).”

“Tomorrow 2” became one of the biggest moments of GloRilla’s early career, reaching the top 10 of the Billboard Hot 100. Cardi came through and gave the track an unforgettable verse.
